title: thlaspi dolichocarpum
intro: Thlaspi dolichocarpum, commonly known as long-stalked penny cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Thlaspi dolichocarpum are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including glucosinolates, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer properties. However, further research is needed to fully elucidate the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of this plant.
